'''NPCs can be treated like players by many other plugins, anti-pvp plugins may interfere with Sentry!

These are the permissions for /sentry commands

Default access is Op.

sentry.*

:sentry.guard
:sentry.equip
:sentry.info
:sentry.warning
:sentry.greeting
:sentry.target
:sentry.ignore
:sentry.stats.*
::sentry.stats.strength
::sentry.stats.armor
::sentry.stats.speed
::sentry.stats.nightvision
::sentry.stats.respawn
::sentry.stats.health
::sentry.stats.attackrate
::sentry.stats.healrate
::sentry.stats.range
::sentry.stats.warningrange
:sentry.options.*
::sentry.options.invincible
::sentry.options.retaliate
::sentry.options.drops
::sentry.options.killdrops
::sentry.options.criticals
::sentry.options.friendlyfire
